description: API schema for Open WebUI. Lists all API paths the app calls, their data domains, and whether the Identity Agent intercepts them.

endpoints.namespace: inbound (served via display reverse proxy at /apps/openwebui/)
endpoints.description: List all conversations in the inbox. Intercepted by the display proxy before reaching the container — served directly from ai-memory.db.

endpoints.namespace: inbound (served via display reverse proxy at /apps/openwebui/)
endpoints.description: Get a single conversation with full message history. Intercepted by the display proxy — served from ai-memory.db.
Send chat completion request to LLM via OpenRouter. Intercepted by the Identity Agent LLM proxy — conversation captured to ai-memory.db and forwarded to OpenRouter.
List available LLM models. Served from a static catalog in the Identity Agent — no upstream call made.

endpoints.namespace: inbound (forwarded to container via display reverse proxy)
endpoints.description: Get UI configuration and feature flags. Forwarded to the container's own backend.

endpoints.namespace: inbound (forwarded to container via display reverse proxy)
endpoints.description: User authentication. Disabled via WEBUI_AUTH=false — container returns an auto-session. Not intercepted.

endpoints.namespace: inbound (forwarded to container via display reverse proxy)
endpoints.description: List models available in the UI dropdown. Served by the container — populated from the Open WebUI model registry.

notes: URL namespace convention: /sandbox/* = container egress (calls FROM the container TO the Identity Agent); inbound paths are container-internal paths intercepted or forwarded by the display reverse proxy at /apps/{app_id}/. 'intercept: true' endpoints are served by the Identity Agent. 'intercept: false' endpoints are forwarded to the container. 'capture: true' means request/response data is written to the specified data domain.
